records.name: Never touch system folders
records.description: Blocks Windows, Program Files, ProgramData, AppData unless explicitly whitelisted.

records.name: Never delete directly
records.description: Deletion always routes to delete-later quarantine with hold period.

records.name: Protect project roots
records.description: Detect .git, package.json, node_modules, venv, lockfiles, solution/project files.

records.name: Protect secrets/config
records.description: .env, keys, tokens, credentials, config DBs never auto-publish/move/delete.

records.name: Write ledger for every action
records.description: Before/after path, hash, confidence, user decision, timestamp.

records.name: Preview before action
records.description: Show exact before/after plan before execution.

records.name: Confidence gate
records.description: Below review threshold = review only; above auto threshold = still block if risky.

records.name: Hash before duplicate decisions
records.description: No duplicate keeper/delete-later decision without hash or content check.

records.name: Max files per run
records.description: Automation stops if file count exceeds threshold unless user overrides.

records.name: Rollback plan required
records.description: Move/rename/archive must write rollback rows before execution.

records.name: Skip low-confidence actions
records.description: Actions on low-confidence files become suggestions only.
